ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an accelerating electric-field device, and the particle moves from left to right; afterward, the particle enters the electric field between two horizontal parallel conducting plates from the middle of the two plates along the horizontal direction, and the electric field between the plates makes its trajectory deflect downward. After leaving the parallel plates, the particle enters the uniform magnetic-field region from point M at the vertical dashed boundary on the right side; the magnetic-field region is indicated by crosses, with the direction perpendicular to the paper surface inward, and B is marked in the figure. The particle undergoes circular motion in the magnetic field, and afterward exits again from point N on the same vertical boundary; the vertical distance between the two points M and N is the required D. Reasoning: The particle starts from rest and is accelerated by accelerating voltage U1. According to the kinetic energy theorem, |q|U1 = 1/2 mv0^2, so the horizontal velocity v0 before entering the parallel plates is determined only by U1. When the particle moves between the horizontal parallel plates, the electric-field force is along the vertical direction and only changes the vertical component of velocity; the horizontal component of velocity remains unchanged, namely vx = v0; voltage U2 only affects the vertical component of velocity vy when the particle leaves the plates and the velocity direction when entering the magnetic field. When the particle enters the magnetic field, its speed is v, and the radius of circular motion is R = mv/(|q|B). In the magnetic field, the circular trajectory intersects the vertical boundary at the two points M and N. From the geometric relation between a circle and a vertical chord, the chord length D = 2R·(vx/v). Substituting R gives D = 2m vx/(|q|B). Since vx = v0, and v0 is determined only by U1, D varies with U1; although U2 changes vy and the incident direction, it is canceled in D = 2R·(vx/v), so D is independent of U2. Further speaking, D is proportional to sqrt(U1).

method.method_draft: 先从图像识别装置结构：左侧加速电场后，粒子水平进入两水平平行板间；出板后带有向下偏转的速度进入右侧竖直边界的匀强磁场区，磁场用叉号表示垂直纸面向里；粒子在磁场中作圆周运动，并在竖直边界上从M点入射、N点射出，所求D就是边界上两交点的竖直距离。由文字读取粒子由静止经电压U1加速、平行板电压为U2、忽略重力和边缘效应。用能量关系得进入偏转电场前的水平速度满足 qU1=1/2 mv0^2，所以v0只由U1决定。在平行板电场中，电场力只改变竖直分速度，水平分速度保持vx=v0；U2只影响出板时的竖直分速度和入射磁场的方向角。进入磁场后，速度大小为v，半径R=mv/(qB)。根据圆轨迹与竖直边界相交的几何关系，边界上两交点距离D=2R·(vx/v)=2mvx/(qB)。由于vx=v0只由U1决定，所以D随U1变化，而U2引起的竖直分速度在公式中抵消，D与U2无关。

Further speaking, D is proportional to sqrt(U1).
